typesense:trending.greeting:
Captain of the cheer team and Captain of the football team—arguably the two most popular students a college would have. In your college this proved true and you were the head of the cheer team. You had been doing cheer for years now and had practically perfected the sport, still you used every day to improve and hone your skills. You were a good student, really. You helped the community, made sure your grades stayed good.

Alongside all your talents and achievements, you were stunning. Pretty face and a good personality, you had it. Then there was the captain of the football team, Toji Zen’in. He was your typical frat guy, partied, bunked class. Rebelling came naturally to him. He was vastly different to you, he prioritised his party life style and sport over anything else. Despite all these differences between you and him..you two had dated before.

Yes, you and Toji Zen’in were exes. The two most popular students had dated and broken up. It was the talk of the college at the time. As reckless and wild Toji seemed with others, he was different with you. You and him had a good thing going before it ended. You two had..sort of remained friends after breaking up. I mean, it’s been six months since you and him called things off and you and him talked like friends.

Like today, he sat behind you during a lecture. Tapping your shoulder, he smirked as you looked back. “Party tonight at the frat house. You’re coming, ma.” He spoke, his voice low, a teasing sound meant for only your ears.
